{{Top|leg}}
'''''Weevil''''' was a flight group of 4 [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] that were employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]]. They were stationed onboard the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] to recover lost supplies from the [[XQ5 Platform]] ''[[Hormuuz]]'' that was originally an Alliance base before it was [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|abandoned]] and left to be taken by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] as part of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]]. Once the Rebels regrouped they [[Attack on the Gelgelar system|returned]] to recover the supplies once after driving off, if not destroy the defences at the base. Once the area was clear of enemies the lifters were launched to pick up 4 [[Class-I cargo container]]s and bring them to the ''Liberty''.
